## Checklist

- [ ] The suffix is open (`kz.ci`, `pvf.cc`, `us.ci`, `xyz.ci`, …)
- [ ] The name is not already in `data/names.txt`
- [ ] The owner address belongs to the person who asked, and they agreed to the terms and the privacy notice
- [ ] The request comes from a public issue (link it below)
- [ ] I understand a merged entry is published to DNS as soon as the owner registers
